Title: AI/ML Engineer
Description:
The fastest-growing European SaaS company is searching for a Senior AI/ML Engineer!




⚠️ Before you apply:

We consider candidates based in Europe only.

We require real 3D CV experience — meaning actual project work, not just listed skills. If 3D CV does not appear in your actual work history, this role is not for you.

Applications that don't meet these criteria will be automatically rejected and may limit your eligibility for other DocuSketch roles.




About DocuSketch:

DocuSketch, with its European Headquarters in Potsdam, Germany, is a leading European software technology provider for the digital real estate economy. With our product brands Immoviewer and DocuSketch, we have become one of the most successful and fastest-growing software vendors in the rapidly expanding property tech sector. Our enthusiastic customer base is located across Europe and North America. DocuSketch's groundbreaking digital technology greatly facilitates real estate companies and building restoration companies in digitizing, visualizing, and virtualizing real estate properties. Our solutions help our clients realize tremendous cost-saving potential, process optimization, and revenue growth.




You’ll be working in a team that drives the company's AI development to develop algorithms for a variety of different use cases. This includes, e.g., working with equirectangular, phone, or satellite images to detect doors, windows, or other objects inside buildings or finding facets on the roof. You’ll be challenged by solving complex 3D geometry problems and working closely with our labeling team to ensure the best possible data quality.




Responsibilities and Duties

· Research, train and deploy state-of-the-art machine learning models for object detection and 3D perception on equirectangular images

· Quickly prototype new ideas/technologies to create proof of concept and demos




Qualifications

· Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

· Excellent math skills

· Experience with 3D computer vision algorithms

· Preferably 5+ years of experience developing and training machine learning models

· Strong Experience with Deep ML frameworks (PyTorch)

· Strong Experience in Python

· Self-motivated and energetic team player with a strong work ethic and cooperative attitude

· Excellent communication and organizational skills




Plus

· Familiarity with building big data systems

· Training very large models using multiple GPUs in the cloud

· Experience with training machine learning models on equirectangular images




We are seeking a performance-driven, high-energy personality who has several years of experience in the field. Since you will work intensely with teams from many countries, a solid command of the English language is a prerequisite. We offer attractive compensation, unlimited career opportunities, and the possibility to work in one of the most exciting software companies in the industry. The position will be remote in any location of your choice in Europe (outside Russia, Belarus, and Ukraine). Our headquarters are in Berlin, Germany, with major offices in Belgrade, Serbia, Lakeland, Florida, and in Canada.




We look forward to receiving your application!

Job Description

The Arctic is warming faster than any other region on Earth. DMI is looking for a scientist to uncover how Arctic sea-ice predictability evolves in a warming climate and to pioneer AI-enhanced approaches that advance our ability to predict sea-ice conditions from seasonal to multi-annual timescales.

The Danish Meteorological Institute (DMI) opens a 4-year, full time position for a post doc research scientist in the Danish National Centre for Climate Research (NCKF), to work with AI-facilitated climate predictions of a seasonally ice-free Arctic in the Novo Nordic Foundation project IcyAlert (https://icyalert.github.io/).

IcyAlert (Intelligent Climate Early Warning Alert for Arctic Ice-Free Summers) is a research project funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation (NNF). The project goal is to improve predictions of Arctic ice-free summers and its potential climate impacts at multi-seasonal time scale using global climate models, causal analysis and machine learning. IcyAlert is led by DMI, in partnership with the Royal Meteorological Institute of Belgium (RMI) and the Technical University of Denmark (DTU).

As part of NCKF at DMI, you will work in a research department with a strong profile in both global and regional climate modelling, as well as remote sensing. You will be part of the Global Climate unit in NCKF.

Title: Quantitative Trader
Place: Aarhus Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
Description:
Do you want to turn market data into trading decisions – and quantitative ideas into real P&L? At Inductive Energy, we are looking for an experienced Quantitative Trader to join our intraday trading team in Aarhus. You will work closely with traders and quantitative colleagues to develop, implement, and refine strategies in the European intraday power markets, with a direct impact on live trading performance.

We are looking for someone who brings experience from power trading, combines quantitative skills with commercial judgement, and enjoys taking ideas from initial research into live markets.




Quantitative Intraday Power Trading

As a Quantitative Trader at Inductive Energy, you will play a key role in strategy development and trading execution. You will work hands-on with market data, models, and trading logic, and help shape how we identify opportunities, deploy strategies, and improve performance. Your responsibilities will include:

Developing, testing, and improving quantitative trading strategies
Turning market hypotheses into signals, models, and trading decisions
Taking part in trading decisions and contributing to real-time P&L
Monitoring and optimizing live trading performance, execution, and risk
Working with large, real-time and historical datasets (prices, forecasts, flows, weather, fundamentals)
Identifying where models break down and improving robustness and performance
Collaborating closely with traders to translate quantitative insights into practical decisions
Contributing to the continuous development of our trading systems and infrastructure

AI-assisted development is a natural part of our workflow, helping us explore ideas, build tools, and iterate efficiently. We value people who use these tools thoughtfully alongside strong technical skills and market understanding.




We Are Looking for Someone Who

Has professional experience in power trading, ideally within European intraday markets, through trading, quantitative research, or strategy development.
Has a strong quantitative background (e.g. Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Economics, Computer Science, or similar)
Is proficient in Python and SQL; experience with PostgreSQL is a plus.
Has practical experience with modelling, forecasting, backtesting, and developing data-driven trading strategies.
Understands the difference between strong backtests and robust live trading performance
Is comfortable working with messy, high-volume, time-dependent data
Is curious about markets and motivated by performance and continuous improvement
Takes ownership and can work independently in a fast-paced environment
Communicates clearly and collaborates well with both traders and technical colleagues




What We Offer

A role with direct impact on trading performance, strategy development, and live P&L
Close proximity to live markets and real-time decision-making
A collaborative environment with traders, analysts, and quantitative colleagues
A high degree of ownership and responsibility from day one
Short path from idea to live trading, with fast feedback loops and continuous iteration
A performance-driven environment where your contributions are evaluated based on real trading performance and P&L impact
Competitive compensation aligned with impact and contribution
A modern office at Katrinebjerg in Aarhus, at the center of a strong tech environment




About Us

Inductive Energy is an energy trading company focused on short-term price movements in the European power markets. We specialize in intraday trading, combining market understanding, quantitative models, and real-time execution to identify and act on opportunities. Our setup is built around fast iteration, data-driven decisions, and close collaboration between trading and quantitative development.

Title: Commercial AI & Data Lead - Aurocon
Description:
Kan du omsætte data fra Aurocons intelligente IoT-forbundne Aurotrap-enheder til konkrete produkter, bedre beslutningsgrundlag og nye kommercielle muligheder?




Fra IoT-data til produktudvikling og forretningsmuligheder




Aurocons voksende base af IoT-forbundne Aurotrap-enheder genererer store mængder data om blandt andet hændelser, sensoraktivitet, connectivity, batteri, drift og installationer. Som ansvarlig for AI & Data bringer du disse data i spil.




Stillingen kombinerer strategi med hands-on udvikling, og særligt i starten er du selv den tekniske drivkraft. Du analyserer data, skriver kode, bygger prototyper og dokumenterer, hvor AI og machine learning kan skabe reel kunde- og forretningsværdi.




Dit ansvar omfatter blandt andet at:

kombinere IoT- og tidsseriedata med produktdata, historiske hændelser, supportviden og teknisk dokumentation
skabe struktur, kvalitet og en skalerbar arkitektur omkring virksomhedens datagrundlag
udvikle machine-learning-løsninger til analyse, anomalidetektion, klassifikation og prædiktion
definere og implementere Aurocons AI- og datastrategi
udvikle fundamentet for en modeluafhængig Aurocon AI Engine baseret på egne data og domæneviden
identificere nye AI- og dataprodukter, der øger værdien af Aurotrap-platformen og kan skabe recurring revenue
arbejde hands-on med LLM'er, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, function calling og AI-agenter
udvikle proof-of-concepts og bringe de rigtige løsninger fra prototype til produktion sammen med CTO og udviklingsteamet




Du refererer direkte til CEO, arbejder tæt sammen med CTO og udviklingsteamet og kommunikerer med både kunder og kommercielle samarbejdspartnere. CTO har ansvaret for hardware, embedded software, firmware og den tekniske produktplatform, mens du får ejerskab for data, analytics, machine learning og AI.




Teknisk builder med blik for produkt og forretning




Du er enten Head of AI i dag eller er klar til dit næste karriereskridt fra din nuværende position som AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist, Applied AI Lead eller tilsvarende. Det afgørende er din tekniske tyngde, evne til selv at bygge løsninger og din ambition om med tiden at tage et strategisk og ledelsesmæssigt ansvar.




Du har solid erfaring med flere af følgende områder:

Data Science, Machine Learning og generativ AI
Python, SQL, data engineering og større datamængder
LLM-arkitektur, RAG, embeddings og vector databases
function calling og AI-agenter
API-integrationer, model deployment og MLOps/LLMOps
cloud-, data- og analyticsarkitektur.




Kendskab til f.eks. Qwen, Llama, Mistral, OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face eller vLLM er relevant. Du er ikke bundet til én teknologistak, men har en pragmatisk tilgang til teknologi og vurderer modeller og løsninger ud fra kvalitet, økonomi, latency, sikkerhed, GDPR, skalerbarhed og den konkrete forretningsværdi.




Derudover har du erfaring med IoT, tidsseriedata, hardware-enabled software og operationelle eventdata.




Du er analytisk stærk, nysgerrig og selvkørende og trives med opgaver, hvor løsningen ikke er defineret på forhånd.




Din tekniske faglighed kombinerer du med et produkt- og forretningsorienteret mindset, der gør dig i stand til at prioritere muligheder ud fra kundeværdi, betalingsvillighed, differentiering, udviklingsomkostninger og skalerbarhed.




En spændende karrieremulighed




Du får en sjælden mulighed for at bygge et strategisk vigtigt område fra bunden. Aurocon har allerede de fysiske produkter, en international installeret base og et voksende datasæt fra enheder i virkelige miljøer. Ambitionen er, at data og AI bliver en central del af virksomhedens næste produktgeneration og langsigtede konkurrenceevne.




I takt med at området vokser, får du mulighed for at opbygge og lede et AI- og datateam. For den rette profil kan stillingen derfor blive et markant karriereskridt fra teknisk specialist til leder med et bredere strategisk teknologiansvar.




Om Aurocon




Auroconudvikler og producerer avancerede løsninger til skadedyrsbekæmpelse baseret på banebrydende teknologi.




Flagskibsproduktet The Aurotrap med tilhørende IT platform og mobil app, er en IoT baseret intelligent, giftfri multi-kill rottefælde, som gør det muligt at overvåge og håndtere rotteaktivitet i realtid.




Fra hovedsædet i Aalborg opererer Aurocon.io på internationale markeder og leverer løsninger, der forbedrer både operationel effektivitet og miljømæssig bæredygtighed.




Læs mere om Aurocon her.

Title: Quant Researcher
Description:
Would you like to manage renewable energy portfolios across European power markets – and use your quantitative skills to make better commercial decisions?




Join our Physical Asset Management team and take responsibility for your own areas of the portfolio. You will work hands-on with market analysis, quantitative models, pricing and PnL while building the market knowledge needed to spot where we can do things better.




The team

You will join Physical Asset Management at Norlys Energy Trading in Aalborg. We manage renewable energy portfolios across European power markets, combining portfolio management with market analysis and quantitative methods. The work involves close interaction with colleagues across trading, origination and asset management.




The role

As a Quant Researcher, you will operate and develop parts of our renewable portfolio across Europe. Over time, you will become the go-to person for your areas of responsibility: understanding what moves the market, how it affects the portfolio and where there is room to improve performance.




The role has a strong quantitative element. You will build models to understand portfolio effects, develop PnL dashboards and work on pricing methodologies and trading automation. You will also investigate new markets and products and help turn promising ideas into new business.




Key responsibilities

The role combines running the portfolio today with improving how we work tomorrow. You will work independently on some areas and together with colleagues and stakeholders in others.




Maintain and operate our renewable portfolios across the EU.
Run your own areas of responsibility with a focus on profitable performance.
Follow your markets closely and build specialist knowledge within your areas.
Build and maintain quantitative models to analyse and optimise portfolio effects.
Develop pricing methodologies and identify ways to improve portfolio performance.
Build and maintain dashboards that show PnL for your portfolios.
Help automate trading tools and processes.
Investigate new markets and products that could create new business opportunities.
Work closely with key stakeholders and take part in relevant conferences and excursions.




The people who thrive in this kind of role are the ones who stay curious when the answer isn’t obvious. You’ll have room to dig into problems, form your own view and act on what you learn. And when the market changes, you need to be comfortable changing your mind with it.

— Peter Lumbye Thomsen, Head of Intraday Analytics




What we are looking for

You are comfortable working with numbers, code and complex market information, but analysis is not an end in itself for you. You want to use it to make decisions, improve the way we work and move things forward when the market changes.




We expect you to have:

An advanced degree in a quantitative field such as physics, economics, data science or mathematics.
Strong programming skills in Python, R or a similar language.
Experience with data analysis and statistical modelling.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
A can-do attitude and a sense of urgency when something needs to move.
An understanding of why agility and speed-to-market matter in a changing market.
The ability to work well with different stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
Experience within power trading or finance is an advantage, but not a requirement.




What we offer

The role gives you room to build specialist knowledge while working hands-on with renewable portfolios across European power markets.

Your own areas of responsibility within renewable portfolio management.
The chance to build specialist knowledge of European power markets.
A role that combines quantitative work with commercial decision-making.
Exposure to new markets, products and business opportunities.
Close collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders across the business.
Participation in relevant conferences and excursions.




Interested?

If the combination of power markets, quantitative analysis and portfolio responsibility sounds like a good match for you, we would like to hear from you.

Title: Quantitative Researcher - Algorithmic Trading
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Join Copenhagen Energy Trading as our next Quantitative Researcher - Algorithmic Trading (Short-term Power Markets)

Copenhagen Energy Trading (CET) shapes the future of the energy transition by combining deep market expertise with technical excellence in data, quantitative research and engineering to drive, automate and optimise our trading operations.




We’re a small, elite team based in central Copenhagen specializing in power trading and asset management across Europe and North America. Technology is core to how we operate, powered by exceptional talent and one of Europe’s most advanced automated and analytical trading environments for power markets. But we're not done. We want to push automation and advanced analytics even further, and to do that we need more exceptional people.




The Opportunity

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for an outstanding Quantitative Researcher with a proven track record of building real-time algorithmic trading strategies that operate with high reliability in regulated industries. You'll play a key role in developing strategies for the European short-term power markets.




This isn't a narrow coding or analyst role. You'll have an end-to-end mandate, from prototyping and data engineering to strategy implementation, backtesting and low-latency execution in our algorithmic trading framework. You'll own your projects from idea to P&L, working autonomously alongside a close-knit group of software engineers, quantitative researchers and expert traders.




So, if you feel energized by the intersection of markets, advanced analytics and trading technology and you want to help build something that moves power to where it’s needed the most, then we must talk.




Responsibilities

Research and model the markets: Analyse energy market dynamics and turn your insights into predictive models that drive profitable trading strategies.
Own the data: Build and maintain high-quality datasets that combine fundamental and real-time market data.
Take strategies to production and keep them running: Own the path from research to live trading, shaping the systems, forecasting tools and data pipelines that run our strategies in real time. Once they're live, you'll monitor their performance, handle issues as they come up and make sure they trade reliably day to day.
Shape the team's direction: Work closely with engineers, quantitative researchers and traders to challenge ideas, share expertise and influence where we take our algorithmic trading next.
Master the domain: Become a domain expert and understand algorithmic trading architectures and order execution logic in the short-term power markets.




Who are you?

You have:

Quantitative expertise: A track record of building accurate forecasting models and trading strategies for financial or energy markets, with a rigorous approach to research and validation.
Software and data skills: Advanced Python skills, and the ability to write clean, efficient, reliable code, backed by solid computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design). Strong data skills, from sourcing and cleaning to structuring complex datasets. Some experience with C++ would be a plus.
Ownership: The ability to work independently and deliver in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication: Excellent problem-solving and communication skills with full professional proficiency in English.
Domain knowledge: A genuine interest in learning about power markets and systems. If you already have that domain knowledge, then that is a big plus.
Education: An advanced degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or Engineering.




What We Offer

Growth environment: Be part of a young, ambitious, and expanding tech-driven trading company where talented people are given responsibility and room to grow.
Exceptional team: Work closely with experienced quantitative researchers, software engineers and power traders.
Competitive compensation and flexibility: Receive a competitive salary package with benefits and enjoy flexible work arrangements that support your work-life balance.
Strong culture: Participate in both social and professional events, including team sports, company parties, teambuilding and informal gatherings that strengthen our team spirit.
Central Copenhagen location: Work from our office in Carlsberg Byen, located in beautifully renovated historic Carlsberg buildings.




About Copenhagen Energy Trading

Copenhagen Energy Trading A/S was founded in 2021 and is part of Copenhagen Energy Group.




We specialize in short-term power trading across Europe and North America. Through technology, data, and market expertise, we develop discretionary and algorithmic trading strategies that help move power to where it is needed most.




Based in Copenhagen, we are building a collaborative, high-performance environment where talented people are trusted with responsibility and given the freedom to make an impact.




How to apply

If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, we would love to hear from you.




Please apply via LinkedIn and submit your cover letter, CV, and university transcripts as a single PDF. Please note that applications that do not meet these requirements may not be considered.




Application deadline: October 23, 2026




If you have any questions, please contact Jens Christian Johannsen at jc@copenhagen-energy.com or Anna Schumann at as@copenhagen-energy.com.

  • Exceptional team: Work closely with experienced quantitative researchers, software engineers and power traders.
  • Competitive compensation and flexibility: Receive a competitive salary package with benefits and enjoy flexible work arrangements that support your work-life balance.
  • Strong culture: Participate in both social and professional events, including team sports, company parties, teambuilding and informal gatherings that strengthen our team spirit.
  • Central Copenhagen location: Work from our office in Carlsberg Byen, located in beautifully renovated historic Carlsberg buildings.


About Copenhagen Energy Trading

Copenhagen Energy Trading A/S was founded in 2021 and is part of Copenhagen Energy Group.


We specialize in short-term power trading across Europe and North America. Through technology, data, and market expertise, we develop discretionary and algorithmic trading strategies that help move power to where it is needed most.


Based in Copenhagen, we are building a collaborative, high-performance environment where talented people are trusted with responsibility and given the freedom to make an impact.


How to apply

If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, we would love to hear from you.


Please apply via LinkedIn and submit your cover letter, CV, and university transcripts as a single PDF. Please note that applications that do not meet these requirements may not be considered.


Application deadline: October 23, 2026


If you have any questions, please contact Jens Christian Johannsen at jc@copenhagen-energy.com or Anna Schumann at as@copenhagen-energy.com.

Title: Vil du hjælpe os med at udvikle FREMTIDENS KVÆGAVL?
Description:
Brænder du for data og statistik, og synes du koen er et fantastisk dyr? Vil du være med til at udvikle et mere bæredygtigt kvægbrug i Danmark? Så er du måske den kollega, vi leder efter til et spændende job i SEGES Innovation.




I SEGES Innovation tilbyder vi dig en karriere med mening. Vores innovation og viden gør en forskel både i hverdagen og på den lange bane. Vores specialister arbejder med alt fra klima og miljø, planter, dyr og digitale løsninger til vækst og vidensformidling. Sammen bidrager vi til de løsninger, der gør landbruget og fødevareproduktionen endnu mere bæredygtig.




I afdelingen for Husdyr søger vi lige nu en person med en uddannelse inden for agrobiologi, statistik, matematik, data science eller lignende. Din uddannelsesbaggrund er dog ikke det vigtigste. Det vigtigste er, at du har stærke analytiske evner, interesse for data og lyst til at være med til at udvikle grundlaget for avlsarbejdet med kvæg i Danmark og Norden.




Hvad skal du lave?

Som vores nye kollega bliver du en del af den afdeling, der har ansvar for udvikling og drift af avlsværdivurdering for malkekvæg, kødkvæg, får og geder. Vi er ni personer, der arbejder tæt sammen om alt fra indsamling af data på den enkelte ko til implementering af avancerede statistiske modeller. Du får ansvar for konkrete opgaver og projekter, men vi bruger aktivt hinandens viden og kompetencer. Vi har nemlig som regel travlt, og vores erfaring er, at vi når længst gennem samarbejde.




Dit arbejdsområde vil primært være udviklingsprojekter, hvor vi udvikler de avlsværdital, som landmænd og avlsorganisationer bruger til at vælge de bedste avlsdyr som forældre til næste generation. Det kan for eksempel være avlsværdital for reduceret metanudledning eller egenskaber, der forbedrer dyrevelfærd og sygdomsresistens. Grundlaget er store mængder data fra blandt andet genomiske tests og målinger på køer og kalve.




Noget af det, vi selv synes er allerbedst ved vores arbejde, er muligheden for at være med til at forme fremtidens projekter og faglige fokusområder. Derfor er opsamling, udvikling og prioritering af nye idéer en vigtig del af vores hverdag. Samtidig motiverer det os at se, at det vi udvikler, bliver anvendt i praksis hos landmændene og gør en reel forskel.




En typisk hverdag

Vi er praktiske talnørder, og vores projekter har typisk en varighed på 1 til 4 år. En normal arbejdsdag starter ofte med statistiske analyser eller udviklingsopgaver. Vi arbejder tæt sammen som gruppe og har faste morgenmøder tre gange om ugen, hvor vi kort deler status på vores opgaver og eventuelle udfordringer.




Selvom du har dine egne ansvarsområder, er der altid en erfaren kollega at sparre med, og Teams bliver flittigt brugt til både store og små spørgsmål i løbet af dagen. Efterhånden som du opbygger erfaring, vil du også få dialog med avlsrådgivere og landmænd samt mulighed for at præsentere resultater og anbefalinger.




Du får dermed en varieret hverdag med mulighed for både fordybelse, faglig udvikling og samarbejde.




Projektporteføljen for 2026 og 2027 er allerede fastlagt, men vi har gode muligheder for at tilpasse dele af opgaverne efter dine interesser og kompetencer.




Vi drømmer om, at du

Har lyst til at analysere store datasæt.
Har lyst til at udvikle nye idéer og eventuelt lede udviklingsprojekter.
Kan kommunikere klart og præcist, både mundtligt og skriftligt.
Kan programmere i SAS eller Python eller har lyst til at lære det.
Har interesse for dataanalyse og lyst til at lære mere om kvægproduktion og avl.




Det får du hos os

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø med mulighed for at udvikle dig inden for statistiske modeller, programmering, projektledelse og formidling af komplekse analyser.




Når du starter, har vi en plan klar for både din introduktion til gruppens arbejde og dine første opgaver på kort og længere sigt. Du får tilknyttet en kollega, som sikrer, at du kommer godt i gang.




Har du ikke et indgående kendskab til kvæg, er det ikke noget problem. Vi hjælper dig med at opbygge den nødvendige forståelse, og hvis du har lyst, sender vi dig gerne på besøg i en besætning, så du får et godt indblik i branchen og de problemstillinger, vi arbejder med.




Praktiske oplysninger

Ansættelse ønskes snarest muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Anders Fogh på telefon 51 73 73 23.




Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og til at byde en ny kollega velkommen i arbejdet med at udvikle fremtidens bæredygtige kvægbrug.










Ved rekruttering hos SEGES Innovation prioriterer vi primært din faglige ekspertise og personlighed. Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke, derfor opfordres alle med de rette kompetencer til at søge - uanset etnisk tilhørsforhold, religion, kønsidentitet og alder.




SEGES Innovation er en uafhængig forsknings- og innovationsvirksomhed, der arbejder for en bæredygtig og konkurrencedygtig landbrugs- og fødevareproduktion. Vi kobler faglige indsigter med digitale teknologier, så ny viden kommer ud at virke i stalden, på marken og i hele værdikæden fra jord til bord.




Vores mange forskellige eksperter udgør et unikt fagmiljø i international topklasse med ca. 500 dedikerede kolleger, der arbejder ud fra værdierne Mod, Hjerte og Dybde og i tæt samspil med Danmarks mere end 30.000 landbrug, universiteter og uddannelsesinstitutioner, landbrugsrådgivere, fødevareproducenter, energiselskaber og myndigheder.

Title: Postdoc in Multi-Modal Behavioural Modelling - DTU Compute
Place: Kongens Lyngby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

If you are looking to establish yourself as a researcher in the cross-disciplinary fields of machine learning and mental health, this postdoc position is for you.

At DTU Compute you will focus is on building multi modal models for mental health applications in a Danish context. You will collaborate with a mental health department at the hospital (Region H), startup companies, as well as Denmark’s AI research and development house, Alexandra Instituttet. Our joint grand solution project is providing foundational models (wearables, speech, video) for behavioural modelling across several mental health applications.

Responsibilities And Qualifications

As part of the position, you will be responsible for:


Data collection activities
Data annotation activities
Developing novel models for multi modalities, herein wearables, speech, and/or video
Pursuing the aims of making foundation models more representative.
Modelling data from mental health applications in collaboration with mental health experts
Conducting computational research experiments and disseminating these in research papers
Good collaborations with project partners (incl. hospitals and companies)


We are looking for you with


Outstanding interdisciplinary collaboration skills
Good organizational/project management skills
Excellent research skills in machine learning and an
Interest in mental health applications


As a formal qualification, you must hold a PhD degree (or equivalent).

We offer

DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and terms of employment

The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures .

The period of employment is 22 months. Start date is according to mutual agreement. The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here .

Further information

Further information may be obtained from Line Clemmensen, Lkhc@dtu.dk .

You can read more about DTU Compute at www.compute.dtu.dk .

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark .

Application procedure

Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 12 October 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:


Application (cover letter)
CV
Academic Diplomas (MSc/PhD – in English)
List of publications


Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Compute – Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science – is an internationally recognised academic environment with over 400 employees and 10 research sections. We broadly cover digital technologies within mathematics, data science, computer science, and computer engineering, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, internet of things (IoT), chip design, cybersecurity, human-computer interaction, social networks, fairness, and data ethics. Our research is rooted in basic research and centres on mathematical models of the physical and virtual world, as a basis for the analysis, design, and implementation of complex systems. We focus on ensuring that our research results contribute to creating a better society by supporting areas such as health, green transition, energy supply, and life science. We collaborate with universities, public and private organisations, and companies in Denmark and abroad, and through DTU’s startup ecosystem, we encourage innovation and entrepreneurship. We have a strong ethical, human, and sustainable approach that ensures integrity in our work. Therefore, we strive for and take responsibility for driving the democratisation of digital technologies, so that everyone has the opportunity to actively participate in the development, and we ensure a continued open, democratic, and inclusive society for the benefit of all. At DTU Compute, we value diversity, inclusion, and a flexible work-life balance. Read more here: www.compute.dtu.dk .

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829

DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

Title: Bliv AI-løsningsudvikler i vores nye AI-enhed
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Byg AI-løsninger, der virker i virkeligheden

En AI-løsning kan se fantastisk ud i en demo og stadig fejle, når den møder virkeligheden. Hos Trafikstyrelsen får du mulighed for at udvikle løsninger, hvor AI er en central del af funktionaliteten – og følge dem fra idé og eksperiment til løsninger, der kan anvendes i praksis.

Vær med til at bygge vores AI Lab

Du bliver en del af IT og Digitalisering, hvor vi er ved at etablere et nyt AI Lab. Du kommer derfor ind i et område under opbygning og får mulighed for at præge både vores løsninger og måden, vi kommer til at arbejde med AI på. Vi arbejder tæt sammen med Trafikstyrelsens fagområder om at finde de steder, hvor AI kan skabe reel værdi.

Sådan bliver din hverdag hos os

Du Arbejder Tæt Sammen Med Fagkontorerne Om At Forstå Deres Arbejdsgange Og Problemer Og Omsætte Dem Til Løsninger, Hvor AI Anvendes, Når Det Giver Mening. Det Kan Være Generativ AI, Men Også Analyse Af Dokumenter Og Billeder, Informationsudtræk Eller Klassifikation. Du Arbejder Fra De Første Prototyper Til Løsninger, Der Kan Integreres Med Vores Systemer, Testes Og Fungere Stabilt i Praksis. Dine Vigtigste Opgaver Bliver At


udvikle og vedligeholde løsninger, hvor AI indgår som en central del.
afprøve forskellige AI-metoder og omsætte de gode prototyper til robuste løsninger.
integrere AI med eksisterende systemer, data og arbejdsgange.
evaluere kvalitet, fejl og usikkerhed systematisk.
sikre en sikker og ansvarlig anvendelse af AI.


Hvad skal du kunne?

Du Har Et Solidt Fundament Inden For Softwareudvikling Og Kan Tage Ansvar For Dine Løsninger Og Arbejde Selvstændigt i Et Område Under Opbygning. Det Er Et Krav, At Du Har En Relevant Teknisk Kandidatuddannelse Inden For Fx Datalogi, Data Science, Kunstig Intelligens, Softwareudvikling Eller Tilsvarende. Vi Lægger Vægt På, At Du


kan programmere og integrere AI med eksisterende systemer og datakilder.
har praktisk erfaring med forskellige AI-teknologier og -metoder, f.eks. generativ AI, dokument- og billedanalyse, informationsudtræk eller klassifikation.
har arbejdet med sprogmodeller og relevante AI-mønstre som RAG og agentbaserede løsninger.
kan evaluere og teste AI-løsninger og forholde dig til kvalitet, fejl og usikkerhed i resultaterne.
forstår betydningen af data, sikkerhed og guardrails, når AI indgår i løsninger.


Vi forventer, at du har praktisk erfaring med at bygge AI-løsninger og har arbejdet med flere af de nævnte teknologier og metoder. Du behøver ikke være specialist i dem alle, men du skal have en bred forståelse af AI og kunne vurdere, hvilken tilgang der passer til problemet. Du tager naturligt initiativ til dialog på tværs af organisationen. Du opsøger kolleger, deler idéer og erfaringer og er nysgerrig på deres arbejde og udfordringer. Du har lyst til at formidle mulighederne med AI – både i den direkte dialog og på skrift – og trives med, at en væsentlig del af jobbet foregår ude blandt kollegerne og ikke kun foran skærmen.

Det får du hos os

Når vi siger, at vi er en fleksibel arbejdsplads, hvor det er vigtigt, at vores medarbejdere oplever balance mellem arbejdstid og fritid – så mener vi det altså. Vores fikstid er kl. 9-14 (kl. 10-14 om mandagen). Det er her, vi forventer, at du er tilgængelig og arbejder. Hvis du arbejder mere end dine 37 timer, så opsparer du fleks. Den kan du afvikle enten ved hele eller halve fleksdage eller f.eks. ved kortere arbejdsdage i en periode. Generelt har du god mulighed for selv at planlægge og administrere din arbejdsdag, og du kan arbejde hjemme i 2 dage om ugen, hvis dine opgaver tillader det. Title: Data, AI & Engineering Opportunities | Life Sciences
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Are you interested in applying your data, engineering, cloud, or AI expertise within the Life Sciences industry? We are always looking for talented professionals to join the project teams driving this work forward.

At ADC, our Engineering & Analytics (Life Sciences) team is engaged across the full R&D data value chain for pharmaceutical and biotech organisations, from early discovery through clinical development. Our work spans scientific data engineering and GenAI solutions across omics, molecular data and AI engineering. We're also delivering data products and GenAI capabilities that support clinical development and operations within regulated LS environments.

How This Connects To Our Current Work

Our team is actively working across the following areas within Life Sciences:


Omics engineering: building scientific data engineering and GenAI solutions across omics, molecular data and AI engineering, including data-analysis platforms.
Bioinformatics: delivering end-to-end AI solutions built on industry best practices, combining deep domain knowledge with engineering excellence for clinical and biological data.
Clinical data engineering: working with synthetic data flows, clinical data platforms and pipelines, and driving coding best practices in clinical development.
LLM and generative AI applications in pharma: having hands-on experience building agentic and LLM-based products in regulated environments such as Databricks and Azure OpenAI.
Data engineering: building and maintaining pipelines and migration engineering that regulated enterprise rollouts depend on.


We welcome applications from all seniority levels, from junior professionals to experienced specialists and senior consultants.

What You'd Be Working On

Our teams are currently working on a wide range of projects, including:


Clinical, biomedical, omics, or pharmaceutical data
Reliable and scalable data pipelines
Cloud and data platforms such as Databricks
Technologies such as Python, SQL, Spark, and MLflow
Machine learning, LLMs, or generative AI within Life Sciences
Bioinformatics or computational biology solutions


What Happens After You Apply

We'll review your profile, and if it matches what we're currently working on, we'll reach out for an introductory conversation. As this pipeline is intended for future hiring and project needs, there is no specific timeline associated with the application.


Amsterdam Data Collective is an equal opportunity employer. To shape a better future, we value diversity and promote equality. No characteristics are discriminated against, as indicated in Directive 2000/78/EC. We encourage and welcome all applications. Additional arrangements or adjustments to support your application can be discussed further.

Title: Quantitative Analyst
Description:
Do you want to gain a deep understanding of the power market and contribute directly to trading decisions? Do you thrive in a high‑paced, data‑driven environment where your analytical skills shape tomorrow’s strategies? If you’re ready for a role with real responsibility and impact, join our team as a Quantitative Analyst and help drive disciplined, high‑quality trading outcomes.




We are seeking a highly motivated individual with strong quantitative skills to join our team as a Quantitative Analyst. In this role, you will work closely with the team, applying data‑driven insights, modelling, and risk thinking to take ownership of disciplined trading decisions. Your ability to transform analysis and code into actionable insights will directly contribute to improving the quality and profitability of our trading decisions.




In this role, you will gain deep insights into our trading strategies and tools that provide a significant competitive advantage. You can expect a steep learning curve and growth opportunities in an environment where flat hierarchy and team spirit drive our success. You will experience a high degree of autonomy and see your own ideas come to life and see your ideas quickly evolve into tangible solutions that make a meaningful impact on our trading operations.




Key Responsibilities

Market Analysis: Conduct in-depth, data‑driven analysis of power markets including supply and demand fundamentals, regulatory developments, weather‑driven patterns, and geopolitical impacts to uncover actionable trading opportunities and support strategic decision‑making.
Risk Management: Implement robust risk management practices by monitoring position limits, conducting stress testing, and assessing exposure to volatile market conditions to ensure controlled and compliant trading activities.
Tool Development: Develop, maintain, and optimize a range of analytical, real‑time monitoring, and reporting tools that enhance trading decision‑making and operational efficiency. Build automated dashboards and data pipelines to produce accurate, timely reports on trading performance, risk metrics, and key market trends.
Model Development: Continuously improve trading models through back testing and market‑driven data analysis to strengthen and support profitable trading decisions.
Collaboration: Work closely with the team to enhance trading strategies and technical setup, ensuring clear and consistent communication across all team members.
Trading Application: Apply insights from analysis, modelling and risk assessment to confidently support and execute well‑founded trading decisions that meet all required risk, compliance, and performance standards.




Qualifications and Requirements

As a candidate, we expect you:

Hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in mathematics‑economics, economics, statistics, engineering, or another quantitative field.
Have strong quantitative and analytical skills to interpret complex data and translate it into well‑founded trading insights.
Are proficient in Python and comfortable with coding. Experience with other code languages is considered an advantage.
Have a strong interest in financial and energy markets and a desire to deepen your understanding of power‑market dynamics.
Demonstrate excellent problem‑solving skills, high attention to detail, and the ability to adapt quickly to changing market conditions.
Communicate clearly and effectively, presenting technical and analytical concepts in a way that is easy for both technical and non‑technical team members to understand.




What We Offer

As an employer, we offer:

A full-time position that gives you the opportunity to apply your acquired skills.
Support in your role from experienced professionals.
Access to unique technologies and resources.
An opportunity to work at the forefront of power trading, contributing to groundbreaking strategies.
Opportunities for career growth and advancement.
Competitive compensation package.
A modern and brand-new office in the heart of Aarhus.
Professional and committed colleagues with high ambitions.
Inspiring, collaborative, and innovative work environment.
A place where your contributions are recognized and have a meaningful impact on the company's success.




A Profitable Growth Company with a Clear Vision

ENZEE is an ambitious growth company specialized in energy trading across the European continent. We envision a sustainable world and therefore, every day at ENZEE is a day with purpose. We believe that well-functioning and efficient energy markets are a necessity towards a net zero future which is exactly where we contribute with our expertise.




The ENZEE team consists of highly qualified, experienced, and knowledgeable industry professionals with a wide range of expertise in the energy markets. As a member of our team, you can expect a steep learning curve, great career growth opportunities, and the possibility of making a significant contribution.




Jobstart & Type

Full-time position
Location: Aarhus
As soon as possible




Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis, and we encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.




ENZEE is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and therefore we encourage all candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disabilities.




If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact us at recruitment@enzeecommodities.com.

Title: Working in power markets? Let's talk
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Electricity Maps is building the world's most comprehensive electricity data platform. Real-time, historical, and forecasted electricity mix, prices, load, and carbon intensity across markets worldwide.

Power markets are a wide, fast-moving space and one with a lot of room for someone with the right experience to help shape what direction we take. That's why we'd rather meet you now even if we don't have an official role on the page. From there, we can figure out together what makes sense. We especially love hearing from people who come with a view: where you'd add value, what you'd want to work on or what you think we're missing.

Maybe you work in one of the following areas:


Day-ahead and intraday forecasting
BESS and asset optimization
Imbalance and balancing markets
Renewable generation forecasting (wind, solar, etc.)
Power market analytics or trading
Something adjacent


We're interested in talking across all lines of work in these areas: Engineering, ML, product, commercial, analytics, or something else. Whatever angle you come at it from, we're curious to hear it.

What to expect

We read every intro that comes through. If we see something we want to learn more about, we'll reach out to get to know each other and figure out together where your experience could add the most value.

About Electricity Maps

There are two sides to what we do. The first: decarbonizing the grid by making historical, real-time, and forecasted data on electricity mix, load, and carbon intensity available to anyone making smarter decisions across the energy transition.

The second is newer for us - we've started working with energy traders, asset operators, and BESS players in European power markets, building out price forecasting, market signals, and adjacent tooling. It's an area we're growing fast in and one with plenty of room for the right person to help shape where it goes.

The details


Location: Copenhagen (in-office with flexibility)
Compensation: Competitive salary + stock options (when a role materializes)
Benefits: 6 weeks vacation, health insurance, annual company offsite, lunch and snacks at office

Title: AI/ML Engineer
Description:
The fastest-growing European SaaS company is searching for a Senior AI/ML Engineer!




⚠️ Before you apply:

We consider candidates based in Europe only.

We require real 3D CV experience — meaning actual project work, not just listed skills. If 3D CV does not appear in your actual work history, this role is not for you.

Applications that don't meet these criteria will be automatically rejected and may limit your eligibility for other DocuSketch roles.




About DocuSketch:

DocuSketch, with its European Headquarters in Potsdam, Germany, is a leading European software technology provider for the digital real estate economy. With our product brands Immoviewer and DocuSketch, we have become one of the most successful and fastest-growing software vendors in the rapidly expanding property tech sector. Our enthusiastic customer base is located across Europe and North America. DocuSketch's groundbreaking digital technology greatly facilitates real estate companies and building restoration companies in digitizing, visualizing, and virtualizing real estate properties. Our solutions help our clients realize tremendous cost-saving potential, process optimization, and revenue growth.




You’ll be working in a team that drives the company's AI development to develop algorithms for a variety of different use cases. This includes, e.g., working with equirectangular, phone, or satellite images to detect doors, windows, or other objects inside buildings or finding facets on the roof. You’ll be challenged by solving complex 3D geometry problems and working closely with our labeling team to ensure the best possible data quality.




Responsibilities and Duties

· Research, train and deploy state-of-the-art machine learning models for object detection and 3D perception on equirectangular images

· Quickly prototype new ideas/technologies to create proof of concept and demos




Qualifications

· Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

· Excellent math skills

· Experience with 3D computer vision algorithms

· Preferably 5+ years of experience developing and training machine learning models

· Strong Experience with Deep ML frameworks (PyTorch)

· Strong Experience in Python

· Self-motivated and energetic team player with a strong work ethic and cooperative attitude

· Excellent communication and organizational skills




Plus

· Familiarity with building big data systems

· Training very large models using multiple GPUs in the cloud

· Experience with training machine learning models on equirectangular images




We are seeking a performance-driven, high-energy personality who has several years of experience in the field. Since you will work intensely with teams from many countries, a solid command of the English language is a prerequisite. We offer attractive compensation, unlimited career opportunities, and the possibility to work in one of the most exciting software companies in the industry. The position will be remote in any location of your choice in Europe (outside Russia, Belarus, and Ukraine). Our headquarters are in Berlin, Germany, with major offices in Belgrade, Serbia, Lakeland, Florida, and in Canada.




We look forward to receiving your application!

Title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Veo you will get to work on challenging problems and directly contribute to the value created by our AI-driven end-user products.

You will become part of our AI team, which comprises 20+ researchers and engineers responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across different projects - from scoping and defining data annotation tasks to modeling, validation, and deployment. You will take ownership of the direction and execution of your projects while collaborating closely with the rest of the team, exchanging feedback, and helping others improve and succeed.

We stay current with the latest research and continuously discuss concepts and ideas in recent papers to assess their relevance to our tasks and product-specific challenges.

We are looking for an ambitious, high-performing senior engineer or researcher with a strong track record of delivering real-world machine learning systems. You should bring the technical depth and judgment needed to make sound decisions in complex and sometimes ambiguous environments.

What you will do:


Train state-of-the-art machine learning models
Write efficient inference pipelines for cloud and edge
Define and supervise data annotation tasks
Improve evaluation schemes to increase understanding of model performance and shortcomings
Contribute to long-term planning and prioritization of tasks
Mentor colleagues and raise the technical bar through feedback, knowledge sharing, and collaboration


What you could bring:


MSc or PhD in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience
Extensive hands-on experience delivering real-world, large-scale machine learning projects
Strong coding and software engineering skills, with experience building maintainable production systems
Experience taking ownership of technically complex projects from concept to deployment
Sound technical judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguity and balance research, product, and engineering considerations
A rigorous and critical approach to examining details, assumptions, and results
Strong communication skills and the ability to influence technical direction across teams


Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

Title: PostDoc - Uncertainty-Aware Optimization in Inverse Problems for Next-Generation 3D Scanning
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
3Shape and DTU Compute (Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science at the Technical University of Denmark) invite applications for an Industrial Postdoctoral position partially funded by Innovation Fund Denmark. The position is a 2-year fixed-term appointment starting in January 2027 (small variations in the start date may be possible depending on the candidate’s preference).




The project addresses a fundamental challenge in computational imaging and large-scale optimization: how can uncertainty in measurements be quantified, propagated, and ultimately leveraged to improve the reliability of reconstructed 3d models?




Modern 3D scanning systems rely on advanced optimization algorithms to reconstruct geometry and color from large volumes of sensor data. While these algorithms produce highly accurate results, they typically provide limited information about the confidence and uncertainty associated with the reconstructed output. Developing methods that can efficiently estimate and propagate uncertainty in the input data through large-scale iterative optimization algorithms has the potential to improve reconstruction quality, enable more informed algorithmic decisions, and support the next generation of intelligent scanning systems.




The successful candidate will conduct research at the intersection of numerical linear algebra, optimization, uncertainty quantification, and computational imaging. The project will investigate: (i) how to characterize measurement uncertainty, (ii) how uncertainty propagates through iterative solvers, (iii) how to develop new mathematical frameworks for uncertainty-aware optimization, and (iv) how to validate the proposed methods through simulations and deployment in medical 3D reconstruction algorithms developed at 3Shape.




The position offers a unique opportunity to combine fundamental research with industrial impact. Working closely with leading researchers at DTU and engineers at 3Shape, the candidate will contribute to scientific publications, software prototype development, and innovation activities aimed at strengthening the theoretical foundations and practical performance of future 3D scanning technologies.




About us

At 3Shape we aim to advance dental treatment and diagnostics with advanced software and 3D scanners designed for dental professionals across the globe. Our purpose is to advance innovation in dentistry, continuously enhancing patient care and outcomes.




This role places you at the heart of our technological advancements within Product Creation, namely TRIOS & SCANNER SW, offering the chance to shape the trajectory of our innovative products and software applications.




About the project

The project is a 2-year project between 3Shape and the Technical University of Denmark, partly funded by Innovation Fund Denmark. The academic co-supervisor will be Professor Per Christian Hansen at DTU Compute (Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science).




The research focuses on uncertainty-aware methods for large-scale linear least squares problems, which form the mathematical backbone of many inverse problems and optimization tasks in 3D reconstruction. The objective is to develop new theoretical and computational tools for quantifying and propagating uncertainty through iterative solution methods, and to translate these developments into practical algorithms for medical 3D reconstruction systems.




What You’ll Do

In this role, you will contribute both to the theoretical foundation and the practical implementation of next-generation uncertainty-aware reconstruction algorithms. The work spans mathematical modelling, algorithm design, and software development in a medical imaging 3D reconstruction.

You will:

Develop methods for characterizing measurement uncertainty in medical 3D scanning data, including data-driven approaches and machine learning methods where appropriate, to obtain realistic and application-relevant uncertainty models.
Work hands-on with numerical algorithms, including iterative methods such as Krylov subspace methods and related solvers.
Develop and analyse new methods for uncertainty-aware linear least squares optimization, with a focus on large-scale iterative solvers.
Design mathematical frameworks for quantifying how uncertainty evolves through optimization algorithms used in 3D reconstruction.
Contribute to the architectural design of uncertainty-aware components within existing reconstruction pipelines.
Translate theoretical models into efficient, scalable implementations suitable for industrial use.
Design and run simulation studies to validate theoretical developments under realistic conditions.
Collaborate with researchers and engineers to integrate new methods into production-oriented 3D scanning systems.
Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, technical reports, and potential patentable innovations.




What We’re Looking For

A PhD in Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline. The PhD must have been awarded after March 2021 (or will be obtained within November 2026).
Strong expertise in numerical linear algebra, optimization, and/or inverse problems.
Solid understanding of linear least squares methods and iterative solvers, ideally methods based on Krylov subspace methods.
Experience with or strong interest in uncertainty quantification, statistical modelling, or probabilistic methods.
Strong programming skills in at least one programming language (ideally two), such as C#, C++, or Python.
Familiarity with machine learning methods is an advantage, particularly for data-driven modelling of complex systems.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of research problems while also contributing to a collaborative industrial-academic environment.
Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex mathematical ideas clearly in both academic and applied settings.




What 3Shape offers

A vibrant and international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled and collaborative colleagues - we are more than 50 nationalities in our DK based office
Breakfast every day, and delicious and healthy lunch cooked by our private chefs.
We provide a great social work environment with many optional activities and social clubs, ranging from wine & beer, board games, running to bicycle clubs.
Good work/life balance.
Attractive offices and R&D lab spaces in downtown Copenhagen close to Kgs. Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.
Purpose: Endeavor to improve dental patients on a global scale.




Staying true to our values and D&I efforts, we encourage all relevant applicants to apply, and we ask you NOT to add any photos or sensitive information (age, marital status, nationality) during the application process.




We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

Og vil du være med til at omsætte data til løsninger, der bidrager til udvikling af diabetesområdet - både gennem dataleverancer til innovations- og forskningsprojekter og gennem udvikling af nye dataværktøjer til klinisk praksis?

Så er det måske dig, vi søger til en stilling som datakonsulent ved SDCA Innovation - et 1-årigt barselsvikariat pr. 1. december 2026. Der kan eventuelt senere være mulighed for forlængelse. Du bliver en del af et lille hold med hhv. en datamanager og en data scientist, der har indgående kendskab til data inden for diabetesområdet og til sundheds- og BI-data i Region Midtjylland.

Hvem er vi?

SDCA er Region Midtjyllands kraftcenter på diabetesområdet og en organisation, hvor der er plads til udvikling, nysgerrighed og nye idéer. I stillingen bliver du en del af SDCA Innovation, en tværfaglig enhed med 25 medarbejdere, der arbejder med innovations- og designprocesser, digital udvikling, sundhedsdata, læring, adfærdsdesign, projektstyring og implementeringsstøtte.

Sammen med forskere og klinikere arbejder SDCA Innovation med at drive nyskabelse, implementering og udbredelse af nye løsninger, der skaber viden og værdi i praksis – både for personer med diabetes og for sundhedsvæsenet generelt.

Om stillingen

Som datakonsulent bliver du en central del af arbejdet med at skabe datadrevet indsigt og beslutningsstøtte på diabetesområdet. Du kommer både til at bidrage til innovationsprojekter, forskningsprojekter og udvikling af dataværktøjer, der understøtter klinisk praksis, kvalitetsudvikling og ledelsesbeslutninger. Stillingen spænder bredt, og du vil arbejde med hele processen fra afdækning af databehov, datastrukturering og -træk til visualisering og formidling af resultater.

For kandidater med interesse for data science vil der desuden være mulighed for at bidrage til projekter, hvor vi undersøger anvendelsen af AI- og machine learning-metoder på kliniske og driftsgenererede data.

Dine konkrete opgaver vil bestå af


opbygning af kendskab til datalandskabet i Region Midtjylland (BI-data), herunder korrekt databasehåndtering med henblik på dataleverancer og rådgivning
datamanagement i form af afklaring, strukturering og validering af sundhedsdata til brug i forbindelse med innovations- og kvalitetsudviklingsprojekter
udarbejdelse af visualiseringer, der understøtter behovsafdækning, projektudvikling, evaluering og beslutningstagning i innovationsprojekter og kvalitetsudvikling
dialog med klinikere, forskere, projektledere og andre interessenter om databehov, datakvalitet og fortolkning af data
udvikling af dashboards, datavisninger og dataværktøjer til sundhedsprofessionelle og ledelse på tværs af hospitalerne og på sigt også tværsektorielt
levering af data fra Region Midtjyllands datavarehus til større forskningsprojekter på diabetesområdet.


For kandidater med interesse for data science kan opgaverne desuden omfatte


bidrag til udvikling og validering af AI/ML løsninger på kliniske og driftsgenererede data
vurdering af klinisk anvendelighed og implementeringsmuligheder for datadrevne AI/ML beslutningsstøtteløsninger
deltagelse i netværk inden for AI, data science og digital sundhed.


Vi forventer af dig, at du


har erfaring i programmering (SQL og evt. R, Python el.lign)
kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret
har gode kommunikations- og formidlingsevner og kan oversætte viden om data til kollegaer med andre fagligheder
kan arbejde team-orienteret og indgå i et tæt samarbejde, hvor man arbejder fleksibelt og integreret og hjælper hinanden i den daglige opgaveløsning
har en kandidatgrad inden for f.eks. sundhedsteknologi, folkesundhedsvidenskab, informationsvidenskab eller lignende.


Det er desuden en fordel, hvis du har


erfaring med arbejde i sundhedssektoren
erfaring med Tableau, Power BI eller lignende visualiseringsværktøjer
kendskab til data governance, datakvalitet eller datamodellering
interesse og kendskab for AI og machine learning.


Vi kan tilbyde dig


et bredt arbejdsfællesskab med engagerede og tværfaglige kollegaer
at blive en del af en velfungerende enhed med et godt kollegialt og socialt sammenhold
en afvekslende hverdag, hvor du selv er med til at definere og udvikle dine opgaver
et job med stor mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling i en dynamisk organisation, hvor der er højt til loftet og mulighed for selv at præge egne arbejdsopgaver.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Ansættelsen er betinget af en tilfredsstillende børneattest.

Kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte innovationschef Katrine Holm Lindgaard på tlf. 2370 7067 eller på mail katrln@rm.dk

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 14. oktober 2026 og vi forventer at holde samtaler d. 21. og 22. oktober 2026.

Om Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus

Vi tror på, at alle mennesker kan få et godt liv. Et liv fyldt med glæde, livskvalitet og mulighed for at træffe egne frie valg.

Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus er Region Midtjyllands udviklingscenter på diabetesområdet. Vi arbejder for, at mennesker med diabetes kan leve et godt liv - og knække kurven, så færre mennesker får diabetes. Vi udvikler og samarbejder om nye og innovative diabetesindsatser inden for behandling, forebyggelse, forskning og tværsektorielt samarbejde. I særlig grad til gavn for alle, som er påvirket af diabetes, men i høj grad også til gavn for det samlede danske sundhedsvæsen.

Vi er drevet og ejet af Region Midtjylland, støttet af en 10-årig bevilling fra Novo Nordisk Fonden og er fysisk placeret på Aarhus Universitetshospital.


Mød nogle af dine måske kommende kolleger.
Læs mere om Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus.
Følg os på LinkedIn.


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret til samtale.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Title: AI/ML Specialist, CMC Development
Place: Gladsaxe, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
AI/ML Specialist

CMC Development

CMC Digital Value & Foundation

Location: Bagsværd

Your impact begins here

Are you ready to set the direction for how AI creates value in Chemistry, Manufacturing and Control (CMC) Development? We are looking for an AI specialist who combines deep technical expertise with business understanding and a passion for solving complex challenges. In this role, you will help shape the long-term AI strategy for CMC and deliver practical solutions that improve efficiency, accelerate decision-making and support Novo Nordisk’s digital transformation.

What You’ll Do

As our new AI/ML Specialist, you will lead the AI agenda across CMC. Acting as the bridge between science, technology, data and business priorities, you will shape how AI is adopted responsibly and translated into measurable value.

This specialist role combines strategic ownership with hands-on delivery. Your first priorities will be to assess the existing AI landscape and develop an AI strategy and architecture for CMC. You will work within enterprise guardrails, align with Enterprise AI and ensure AI priorities connect with the wider team’s data and information roadmaps.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


Setting and evolving the AI strategy, roadmap and architecture for CMC, defining what successful and responsible AI adoption should look like in the years ahead.
Identifying, prioritising and delivering high-value AI and machine learning opportunities from exploration and modelling through to implementation, deployment and adoption.
Developing practical business solutions and measuring impact through outcomes such as time saved, efficiency gains, usage and contribution to strategic priorities.
Translating future AI needs into clear requirements in partnership with data engineers, information modellers and domain specialists.
Representing CMC in enterprise AI forums, advising senior stakeholders and running inspiration sessions that show what AI can achieve in a regulated scientific environment.


The role offers substantial autonomy as the central AI specialist for an organisation spanning research, production and supply chain activities. You will work with varied scientific and operational challenges in an entrepreneurial environment where promising ideas can be tested, learned from and moved forward.

Who You’ll Work With

CMC Development's role in Novo's value chain is to turn molecules into approved products in close cooperation with our colleagues in R&ED, Development and Global Manufacturing and Supply.

You will join the CMC Digital Value & Foundation team, the central data team supporting CMC. The team brings together information modellers, data engineers and domain specialists to standardise, package and make data available for scalable digital and AI solutions.

Your primary office will be in Bagsværd. As close engagement with CMC stakeholders is central to the position, you should expect regular collaboration across relevant local CMC sites, e.g. in Måløv and Ballerup.

What You’ll Bring

You combine strong AI and machine learning expertise with commercial awareness and an understanding of how technology can address real business needs. You move comfortably between strategic discussions and technical implementation, focusing on customer value and demonstrated outcomes.

We Are Looking For Someone Who Brings


Strong applied knowledge of AI and machine learning, with experience developing or implementing solutions that deliver tangible value.
The ability to define AI strategies, roadmaps or architectures while remaining motivated to build, test and deliver hands-on solutions.
A relevant degree in e.g. computer science, software engineering, data science or another related field. An alternative scientific background combined with relevant AI experience is equally welcome.
Experience navigating complex stakeholder landscapes, communicating technical concepts clearly and advising on opportunities, limitations, data considerations and responsible adoption.
Knowledge of CMC, pharmaceutical development or manufacturing is strongly preferred. Experience from another regulated environment may also be relevant.


You are curious and externally oriented, keeping up with a rapidly changing technology landscape while staying focused on priorities that create sustainable value. You can challenge requests constructively, make clear choices and say no when needed. Fluency in written and spoken English is required.

What We Offer

There is more on offer here than our unique culture and results. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600 to 1,091,600 DKK (DK), corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Ben James Jackson at ZBNJ@novonordisk.com.

Deadline

11th October 2026.

We will review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position may be closed before the deadline if we find the right candidate.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
